title: Cluster-Norm for Unsupervised Probing of Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting random words into subsets of prompts to create a highly salient but irrelevant feature, evaluating whether unsupervised probes (like CCS) are distracted into classifying the random words rather than the intended knowledge.

Inserting the explicit or implied opinion of a fictional character ('Alice') into prompt templates to test whether unsupervised probing models align with the character's adversarial opinion instead of predicting the objective ground truth.
